annotations.title: Find a Phorme gym or class

description: Use this when the user wants a gym, studio or class to train at in person, for example "a strength class in Austin this week" or "a gym near me". It returns up to five Phorme gyms and studios in the city named or within 60 km of the position given, nearest or best matching first, each with its page on phor.me and its classes in the coming days with the class id, local start time, length, places left and a link to book on phor.me. It reads only and shows no prices; booking a class for a signed-in user is a separate step.

city.description: The city the user named, for example "Austin".

class_type.description: The kind of class, only if the user said, for example "barbell" or "yoga".

days.description: How many days ahead to look. Default 7.

near_lat.description: Latitude, only if the user shared their position.

near_lon.description: Longitude, only if the user shared their position.

name: find_gym_class

limits.description: What this does not cover. Tell the user.

places.description: Gyms and studios, nearest or best matching first: place_id, name, kind, line, city, country, distance_km, page_url and classes (class_id, the id book_gym_class takes, then title, line, starts, minutes, spots_left, book_url).

title: Find a Phorme gym or class
